# Morph › Object

**What belongs here.** A depicted object becomes another object.

**Examples.** cup → planet

**Family test.** Is something visibly one thing at the start and another thing at the end?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).
